projects.title: 显示屏 · LCD Digits
projects.summary: Draw a string of digits on a 3×5 dot display, printed one screen row at a time from a glyph table.

demos.name: LCD Digits
demos.desc: Type any digits and see the display and the exact text output.

demos.name: Row by Row
demos.desc: Steps through the solution line by line on the sample.

projects.title: 数的计算 · Half Prefix
projects.summary: Count the numbers you can build by prefixing digits at most half the current front, using a one-line DP.

demos.name: Half Prefix
demos.desc: A step-by-step trace of the code filling dp[].

projects.title: 过河卒 · River Pawn
projects.summary: Count right/down paths across a grid while avoiding a horse and every square it can jump to.

demos.name: River Pawn
demos.desc: Set your own board and watch the DP table fill in.

projects.title: 栈 · Stack Permutations
projects.summary: Count the possible stack output orders — the Catalan numbers — with two proofs of the recurrence.

demos.name: Stack Permutation Trace
demos.desc: The execution trace, plus all 5 sequences for n = 3 grouped by when element 1 leaves.

projects.title: High-Precision Arithmetic
projects.summary: Add, subtract, multiply and divide numbers far bigger than long long, digit by digit with carries and borrows.

demos.name: 高精度运算演示
demos.desc: Steps through add(), mul(), sub() and divInt() showing every carry, borrow and remainder.
